patthana2.1:1.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. I.
patthana2.1:2.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho; adosaṃ paṭicca alobho amoho; amohaṃ paṭicca alobho adoso. Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho; mohaṃ paṭicca lobho; dosaṃ paṭicca moho; mohaṃ paṭicca doso. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:3.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3.
patthana2.1:4.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:5.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . 5.
patthana2.1:6.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca hetū. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca hetū. 6.
patthana2.1:7.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā hetū ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā hetu ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. 7.
patthana2.1:8.1: Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Alobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca adoso amoho . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho, dosañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe alobhañ ca vatthuñ ca paṭicca adoso amoho . . . pe . . . 8.
patthana2.1:9.1: Hetuñ ca na hetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca hetuñ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Dve khandhe ca hetuñ ca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuñ ca hetuñ ca paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. 9.
patthana2.1:10.1: Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca alobhañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā adoso amoho cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve khandhe ca alobhañ ca paṭicca dve khandhā adoso amoho cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca lobhañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . dve khandhe . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuñ ca alobhañ ca paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā . . . pe . . .
patthana2.1:11.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā . . . (rūpaṃ chaḍḍetvā arūpe yeva nava pañhā) . . . adhipatipaccayā . . . (paṭisandhi natthi, paripuṇṇaṃ). Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca . . . pe . . . mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, upādā rūpaṃ (idaṃ ninnānaṃ) . . . anantarapaccayā . . . samanantarapaccayā . . . sahajātapaccayā . . . (sabbe mahābhūtā yāva asaññasattā) . . . aññamaññapaccayā . . . nissayapaccayā . . . upanissayapaccayā . . . purejātapaccayā . . . āsevanapaccayā . . . (dvīsu paṭisandhi natthi) . . . kammapaccayā . . . vipākapaccayā . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . avigatapaccayā . . .
patthana2.1:12.1: Hetuyā nava, sabbattha nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana2.1:14.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā. Ahetukaṃ nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . pe . . . 5.
patthana2.1:15.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetudhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. 2.
patthana2.1:16.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. Hetuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:17.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . (sabbe mahābhūtā) . . . 8.
patthana2.1:18.1: Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. Hetuñ ca nahetū ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . nādhipatipaccayā . . . (paripuṇṇaṃ) . . . nānantarapaccayā . . . nasamanantarapaccayā . . . na aññamaññapaccayā . . . na upanissayapaccayā . . . 1.
patthana2.1:19.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho, mohaṃ paṭicca lobho . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:20.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe hetuṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. Hetuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3.
patthana2.1:21.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho sampayuttakā ca khandhā . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:22.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā. Dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 5.
patthana2.1:23.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetū khandhe paṭicca hetū. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 6.
patthana2.1:24.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā hetū ca; dve khandhe . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 7.
patthana2.1:25.1: Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe alobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca adoso amoho, . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . arūpe lobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 8.
patthana2.1:26.1: Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca hetuñ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve khandhe . . . pe . . . nahetū khandhe ca hetuñ ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 9.
patthana2.1:27.1: Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca alobhaṃ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā adoso amoho ca; . . . pe . . . dve khandhe . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca lobhañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca; . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 1.
patthana2.1:28.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā: . . . pe . . . nāsevanapaccayā . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:29.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Hetuṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. 4.
patthana2.1:30.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. Bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ. 8.
patthana2.1:31.1: Heṭuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. 1.
patthana2.1:32.1: Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā: . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:33.1: Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nāhārapaccayā. Bāhiraṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā. Mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattā-rūpaṃ upādā-rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . . . . na indriyapaccayā . . . Bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . Mahābhūte paṭicca upādā-rūpaṃ asaññasattānaṃ. Mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ. . . . najhānapaccayā . . . Pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ . . . pe . . . bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . pe . . . . . . namaggapaccayā . . . Ahetukaṃ nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ . . . pe . . . . . . nasampayuttapaccayā . . . navippayuttapaccayā . . . (napurejātasadisaṃ, arūpe yeva.) . . . . . . nonatthipaccayā . . . . . . novigatapaccayā . . .
patthana2.1:34.1: Nahetuyā dve, nakamme tīṇi, nārammaṇe tīṇi, navipāke nava, nādhipatiyā nava, nāhāre ekaṃ, nānantare tīṇi, na-indriye ekaṃ, nasamanantare tīṇi, najhāne ekaṃ, na-aññamaññe tīṇi, namagge ekaṃ, na-upanissaye tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, napurejāte nava, navippayutte nava, napacchājāte nava, nonatthiyā tīṇi, nāsevane nava. novigate tīṇi:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana2.1:36.1: Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe nāsevane nava, tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, nādhipatiyā nava, navipāke nava, nānantare tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, (saṃkhittaṃ) navippayutte nava, na upanissaye tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, napurejāte nava, novigate tīṇi.
patthana2.1:38.1: Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe indriye dve, dve, jhāne dve, anantare dve (saṃkhittaṃ), magge ekaṃ, kamme dve, sampayutte dve (saṃkhittaṃ), vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre dve, avigate dve.
patthana2.1:40.1: (Sahajātavāro pi paṭiccavārasadiso; paccayavāro pi nissayavāro pi paṭiccavārasadisā yeva pañhā. Mahābhūtesu niṭṭhitesu vatthuṃ paccayāti kātabbaṃ. Pañcāyatanāni anulome pi paccaniye pi yathā labbhanti tathā kātabbā. Saṃsaṭṭhavāro pi sampayuttavāro pi paripuṇṇā. Rūpaṃ natthi, arūpam eva.)
patthana2.1:41.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Alobho adosassa amohassa hetupaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho mohassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Doso mohassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:42.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Hetu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3.
patthana2.1:43.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Alobho adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho mohassa . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . 1.
patthana2.1:44.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuṃ ārabbha hetū khandhā uppajjanti. 2.
patthana2.1:45.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuṃ ārabbha nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. 3.
patthana2.1:46.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuṃ ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. 4.
patthana2.1:47.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ, nibbāṇaṃ . . . Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā nahetū pahīnakilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhitakilese, pubbe samudācinne kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ, nahetū khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nahetucittasamaṃgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakiriyaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakiriyassa, ākiñcaññāyatanakiriyaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyassa, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Nahetū khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:48.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā . . . (paṭhamagamanaṃ yeva. Āvajjanā natthi. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassāti idaṃ natthi). 6.
patthana2.1:49.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ . . . uposathakammaṃ taṃ paccavekkhati, taṃ ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā upajjanti . . . (tatthatatthaṭṭhitena imaṃ kātabbaṃ dutiyagamanasadisaṃ). 7.
patthana2.1:50.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha hetū uppajjanti. 8.
patthana2.1:51.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. 9.
patthana2.1:52.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. 1.
patthana2.1:53.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- hetuṃ garuṃ katvā hetū uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati: -- hetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:54.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- hetuṃ garuṃ katvā nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati:-- hetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:55.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati . . . garuṃ katvā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. Sahajātādhipati . . . khandhānaṃ hetūnañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:56.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- (dānaṃ datvā ti vitthāretabbaṃ yāva nahetū khandhā). Sahajātādhipati:-- nahetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ. . . . 5.
patthana2.1:57.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- dānaṃ datvā . . . (saṃkhittaṃ yāva vatthu nahetū ca khandhā tāva kātabbaṃ). Sahajātādhipati:-- nahetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ. . . . 6.
patthana2.1:58.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati tam garuṃ katvā nahetū khandhā ca hetū ca uppajjanti. Pubbe suciṇṇāni . . . (yāva vatthu nahetū khandhā ca tāva kātabbam). Sahajātādhipati:-- nahetu adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnañ ca . . . 7.
patthana2.1:59.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati:-- hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe garuṃ katvā hetū uppajjanti. 8.
patthana2.1:60.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati:-- hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe garuṃ katvā nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. 9.
patthana2.1:61.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati . . . katvā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. 1.
patthana2.1:62.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā hetū pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:63.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā . . . pacchimānaṃ nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:64.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Purimā . . . hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:65.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa. . . . Purimā purimā nahetū khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:67.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa . . . (nahetumūlakaṃ tīṇi pi ekasadisaṃ.) 7.
patthana2.1:68.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa. . . . Purimā purimā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.1:69.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa. . . . Purimā . . . pacchimānaṃ nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.1:70.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca. . . . Purimā . . . pacchimānaṃ hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana2.1:71.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo. . . . (anantarasadisaṃ) . . . sahajātapaccayena paccayo . . . aññamaññapaccayena paccayo . . . (ime dve paṭiccavārasadisā) . . . nissayapaccayena paccayo. . . . (paccayavāro nissayavārasadiso). 1.
patthana2.1:72.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- hetū hetūnaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:73.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . hetū nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:74.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:75.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti. . . . Mānaṃ jappeti diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; saddhā . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . catutthassa maggassa . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:76.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo. . . . saddhaṃ . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; saddhā . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:77.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . (dutiya-upanissayasadisaṃ). 7.
patthana2.1:78.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa. . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā hetūnaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.1:79.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa. . . . Ārammanūpanissayo . . . khandhā nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.1:80.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . hetūnañ ca sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:81.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- arahā cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo, . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:82.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthuṃ hetūnaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:83.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . pe . . . Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:84.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā hetū purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:85.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā nahetū khandhā purejātassa . . . 8.
patthana2.1:86.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa. . . . Pacchājātā hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa. . . . 1.
patthana2.1:87.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo . . . (anantarasadisaṃ). 4.
patthana2.1:88.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā:-- nahetu cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā:-- nahetu cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:89.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātā . . . sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā:-- nahetu cetanā vipākānaṃ hetūnaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:90.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Sahajātā: . . . khandhānaṃ hetūnañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca . . . khandhānaṃ hetūnañ ca kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:91.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo. Vipāko alobho adosassa amohassa vipākapaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ. Vipākavibhaṃge nava pañhā). 4.
patthana2.1:92.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Nahetū āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:93.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Nahetū āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 6.
patthana2.1:94.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Nahetū āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānam hetūnaṃ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 1.
patthana2.1:95.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo . . . (hetumūlake tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.1:96.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. Nahetū indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. . . . (evaṃ indriyapaccayo vitthāretabbo, nava). 4.
patthana2.1:97.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 1.
patthana2.1:98.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo . . . sampayuttapaccayena paccayo . . . (imesu dvīsu nava). 2.
patthana2.1:99.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā:-- hetū cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe hetū kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Hetū vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā:-- hetū purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:100.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā:-- nahetū khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nahetū khandhā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . vatthu nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā nahetū khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:101.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ:-- paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu hetūnaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- vatthu hetūnaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:102.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca . . . Sahajātaṃ . . . hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.1:103.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā:-- hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā:-- hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:104.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Alobho adosassa amohassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:105.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . Pacchājātā hetū purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:106.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Alobho adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho mohassa sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:107.1: Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajāto nahetu eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nahetu eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Khandhā vatthussa atthipaccayena paccayo. Vatthu khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ . . . pe . . . Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ . . . pe . . . dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; rūpāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . cakkhāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Vatthu nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā nahetū khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaliṃkāro āhāro imassa . . . Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:108.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātā -- nahetū khandhā sampayuttakānaṃ hetūnaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu hetūnaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . vatthuṃ aniccato . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati . . . dibbena cakkhunā . . . pe . . . saddaṃ suṇāti . . . Vatthu hetūnaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:109.1: Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto nahetu eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ hetūnaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . saddaṃ suṇāti. . . . Vatthuṃ hetūnaṃ sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 7.
patthana2.1:110.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto alobho ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā adosassa amohassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe alobho ca vatthu ca adosassa amohassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ). 8.
patthana2.1:111.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa. . . . Sahajātaṃ . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe hetū ca vatthu ca nahetūnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā hetū ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā hetū ca kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā hetū ca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ ca kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.1:112.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto nahetu eko khandho ca alobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ adosassa amohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Nahetu eko khandho ca lobho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe nahetu eko khandho ca alobho ca vatthu ca adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānaṃ ca khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . pe . . .
patthana2.1:113.1: natthipaccayena paccayo. . . . vigatapaccayena paccayo. . . . avigatapaccayena paccayo. . . .
patthana2.1:114.1: Hetuyā tīṇi, kamme tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, vipāke nava, adhipatiyā nava, āhāre tīṇi, anantare nava, indriye nava, samanantare nava, jhāne tīṇi, sahajāte nava, magge nava, aññamaññe nava, sampayutte nava, nissaye nava, vippayutte pañca, upanissaye nava atthiyā nava, purejāte tīṇi, natthiyā nava, pacchājāte tīṇi, vigate nava, āsevane nava, avigate nava:-- Evaṃ anumajjantena gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana2.1:116.1: Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo . . . sahajāta- . . . upanissayapaccayena paccayo. . . . 2.
patthana2.1:117.1: Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇa. . . sahajāta- . . . upanissaya- . . . purejāta- . . . pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. . . . 3.
patthana2.1:119.1: Nahetu . . . nahetussa . . . ārammaṇa- . . . sahajāta. . . upanissaya- . . . purejāta . . . pacchājāta- . . . kamma- . . . āhāra- . . . indriyapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:120.1: Nahetu . . . hetussa . . . ārammaṇa- . . . sahajāta. . . upanissaya- . . . purejāta- . . . kamma-paccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:122.1: Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa. . . . 8.
patthana2.1:125.1: Nahetuyā nava, (saṃkhittaṃ), nārammaṇe nava, no-avigate nava:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.

patthana2.1:272.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: --dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ, uposathakammaṃ, taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā . . . pe. . . . Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā phalaṃ . . . pe . . . Sahetuke khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati:-- sahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:273.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- sahetukādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:274.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca. . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- sahetukādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:275.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa. . . . Ārammaṇādhipati:-- ariyā nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ . . . pe . . . ahetuke khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati. 1.
patthana2.1:276.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa anantara paccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā sahetukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa, gotrabhu maggassa, vodānaṃ maggassa, maggo phalassa, phalaṃ phalassa, anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:277.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sahetukaṃ cuticittaṃ ahetukassa uppatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sahetukaṃ bhavaṃgaṃ āvajjanāya anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sahetukaṃ bhavaṃgaṃ ahetukassa bhavaṃgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Sahetukā khandhā ahetukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:278.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa . . . Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:279.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Purimo purimo vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho pacchimassa pacchimassa vicikicchāsahagatassa uddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayoPurimā purimā ahetukā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā pañcannaṃ viññāṇānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:280.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa . . . Purimo . . . moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Ahetukaṃ cuticittaṃ sahetukassa uppatticittassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Ahetukaṃ bhavaṃgaṃ sahetukassa bhavaṃgassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Ahetukā khandhā sahetukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:281.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa . . . Purimo . . . khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 7.
patthana2.1:282.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā sahetukassa . . . Purimā . . . khandhā moho ca pacchimānaṃ . . . khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.1:283.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā ahetukassa . . . Purimā purimā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimassa pacchimassa . . . Vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca ahetukassa vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.1:284.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā sahetukassa ca . . . Purimā . . . khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:285.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭiccavāre sahajātasadisaṃ piha ghaṭanā natthi.) . . . aññamaññapaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭiccavārasadisaṃ) . . . nissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭiccavāre nissayapaccayasadisaṃ piha ghaṭanā natthi) . . . pe . . .
patthana2.1:286.1: upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:1-- sahetukā khandhā sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:287.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- sahetukā khandhā ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:288.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo . . . pe . . . khandhā vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:289.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ . . . pe . . . utu bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Moho kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ utu bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ moho ca kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:290.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ . . . pe . . . utu bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ . . . pe . . . mohaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ . . . pe . . . moho ca saddhāya . . . pe . . . paññāya rāgassa . . . pe . . . patthanāya maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:291.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpānissayo:-- kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ moho ca vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 7.
patthana2.1:292.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā sahetukassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatupanissayo:-- vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.1:293.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā ahetukassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo . . . moho ca ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.1:294.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā sahetuko ca. . . . Anantarūpanissayo . . . moho ca vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:295.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ;- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe ahetuko vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ:--4cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:296.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ . . . pe . . . uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe sahetuko vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Vatthupurejātaṃ:--1vatthu sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.1:297.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇāpurejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ ārabbha vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:298.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā sahetukā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:299.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Pacchājātā ahetukā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa . . . 8.
patthana2.1:300.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā ahetukassa . . . Vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:301.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo . . . (anantarasadisaṃ. Āvajjanam pi bhavaṃgam pi natthi. Āsevanapaccaye vajjetabbā nava pi.) 1.
patthana2.1:302.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā sahetukā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā sahetukā cetanā vipākānaṃ sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.1:303.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā sahetukā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā sahetukā cetanā vipākānaṃ ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:304.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa . . . Sahajātā . . . khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā sahetukā . . . khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:305.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Ahetukā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:306.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo. Vipāko sahetuko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ; dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:307.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Vipākā sahetukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3.
patthana2.1:308.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca . . . Vipāko sahetuko . . . 6khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . pe . . . dve. . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:309.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Vipāko ahetuko eko . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:310.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.1:311.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Ahetukā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:312.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.1:313.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Ahetukā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, indriyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:314.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.1:315.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa . . . Ahetukāni jhānaṃgāni sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ jhānapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 1.
patthana2.1:316.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa maggapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 1.
patthana2.1:317.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa sampayuttapaccayena paccayo . . . (Paṭiccavāre sampayuttavārasadisaṃ cha pañhā.) 2.
patthana2.1:318.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā sahetukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe sahetukā khandhā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā:-- sahetukā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.1:319.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā ahetukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe ahetukā khandhā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa . . . pe . . . vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . vatthu ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā ahetukā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa. . . . 5.
patthana2.1:320.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ:-- paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- vatthu . . . 6.
patthana2.1:321.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa. . . . Purejātaṃ vatthu vicikicchāsahagatānaṃ uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.1:322.1: Sahetuko ca ahetuko ca dhammā ahetukassa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā vicikicchāsahagatā . . . moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.1:323.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahetuko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ; dve . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2.
patthana2.1:324.1: Sahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā sahetukā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Vicikicchāsahagatā uddhaccasahagatā khandhā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ . . . paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pacchājātā sahetukā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.1:325.1: Sahetuko dhammo sahetukassa ca ahetukassa. . . . Sahetuko eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ . . . paccayo. Vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca; dve. . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.1:326.1: Ahetuko dhammo ahetukassa dhammassa. . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajāto ahetuko eko . . . pe . . . dve . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭisandhi yāva asaññasattā kātabbaṃ.) Purejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Kusalākusale niruddhe ahetuko vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Vatthu ahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā ahetukā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa. . . . Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.1:327.1: Ahetuko dhammo sahetukassa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Patisandhikkhaṇe vatthu sahetukānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ . . . niruddhe sahetuko vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti.
